title: Monday anchor week identity, holiday masks, fail-closed replay validation, and bounded-resource receipts
notes: Implemented Monday anchor week identity (dt.year, mon_str) eliminating ISO-week collision (e.g. 2024-01-02 vs 2024-12-30) and strictly rejecting malformed dates. Added per-series holiday mask to compute_weekly_sufficient_statistics ensuring unobserved sessions do not accumulate count or sums, matching mathematical oracle (<1e-12). Enforced rejection of missing required market paths. Added fail-closed checks to replay_analysis_bundle verifying contrast counts, draw matrix shapes, finite checks, contrast IDs, arm names, statuses, and tolerances. Added corruption rejection tests for renamed IDs, truncated summary lists, and NaN-corrupted draws. Scoped float64 frequency array allocation (25.04 MB for 313 weeks/10k draws) distinct from measured RSS.
